Smoke test: load gherkin and parse a simple feature

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"gherkin\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "Feature: Calculator\n  Scenario: Add numbers\n    Given I have entered 1\n    When I add 2\n    Then the result should be 3\n", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
